# GlobeSpark

> GlobeSpark is a digital marketing agency based in Kangra, Himachal Pradesh, serving businesses across Dharamshala, Shimla, Solan, Hamirpur and all of Himachal Pradesh. Services include SEO, local SEO / Google Maps ranking, website design & development, social media marketing, performance ads (Meta & Google Ads), content marketing, link building, and industry-specific growth (including hotel marketing in Dharamshala).

## Services

- SEO Services in Himachal Pradesh: technical, on-page and off-page SEO, audits, content and link building.
- Local SEO Expert in Kangra: Google Business Profile optimization, citations and Maps ranking.
- Website Designing Company in Kangra: fast, mobile-first, conversion-focused websites.
- Web Developer in Dharamshala: custom web design and development.
- Social Media & Performance Ads: Meta and Google Ads campaigns.
- Hotel Marketing Dharamshala / HP: growth plans for hotels, schools, clinics and local businesses.
